headline: Approved $63,753.12 for ARPA roads and sidewalks, $30,000 for a domestic violence prosecutor, and funding for fire radio replacement.
summary: Items covered a transfer of $63,753.12 for ARPA roads and sidewalks and a part-time planner, and $30,000 for a domestic violence prosecutor. A Fire Chief request for replacement portable radio equipment before December 2026 was also covered. Donated funds for signage at the Theodore L. Gatsas Municipal Complex were accepted.
decisions: Approved transfer and expenditure of $63,753.12 for ARPA roads and sidewalks and the part-time planner.
Approved acceptance and expenditure of $30,000 for the Domestic Violence Prosecutor.
Approved the Fire Chief's request for funding to replace public safety portable radio equipment.
Approved acceptance and remanding of donated funds for signage at the Theodore L. Gatsas Municipal Complex.

transcript:
## SPECIAL MEETING COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT

October 20, 2026 at 5:30 PM

Chairman Burkush called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Burkush, Vincent, Barry, Goonan, Terrio

1. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and expenditure of funds in the amount of $63,753.12 for CIP 712622 ARPA - Revenue Replacement - Roads and Sidewalks and CIP 810724 Part Time

- Planner.

Chairman Burkush: For the public, this is our Planning Department closely monitoring the ARPA money to make sure that we could use every penny. We’ re going to put some money back in for roads, which is our goal.

On motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to expedite the committee’ s report to the full Board.

2. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and expenditure of funds in the amount of $30,000 for CIP C070040127 Domestic Violence Prosecutor.

On motion of Alderman Terrio , duly seconded by Alderman Vincent , it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman Terrio , duly seconded by Alderman Vincent , it was voted to expedite the committee’ s report to the full Board.

3. Communication from Ryan Cashin, Fire Chief, requesting funding to secure replacement public safety portable radio equipment before December 2026.

(Note: Should the Committee approve of this request, a funding source needs to be identified.)

Chairman Burkush: I’ d ask the committee to report this out of committee so that we can leave it for public review and take it up at the next meeting of the full Board, rather than rush it through.

On motion of Alderman Goonan , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to approve.

October 20, 2026 SPECIAL MEETING COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT

Matthew Normand, City Clerk: We have one item of new business. As the committee recalls, on December 16, 2025, the Board named the Public Works municipal complex after former Mayor Ted Gatsas. That payment has come in this morning, and the Board has to officially accept and remand those funds so they can be transferred for DPW to reimburse all costs.

- Communication from Matthew Normand, City Clerk, requesting the funds
- donated for the signage installation at the Theodore L. Gatsas Municipal

Complex be accepted and remanded for its intended purpose.

On motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman Terrio , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to expedite the committee’ s report to the full Board.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by

Alderman Goonan , it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee

- Meeting End Time: 5:33PM
